verticalDatum: Mars2000 Datum: Martian equipotential surface (areoid), per original HiRISE PDS label; MOLA-controlled elevations in meters. No vertical transformation applied.
limitations: Real NASA/USGS source; independent SCI-03 scientific and operational validation is pending.
2 m output sampling does not imply 2 m horizontal accuracy or resolved terrain detail; stereo matching, jitter, seams and interpolation artifacts may affect slopes.
Source DTM is MOLA-controlled. Source FOM was not classified in this subset; source manual interpolation and low-confidence cells are not identified by the validity mask.
No confirmed hazard layer is available. Valid elevation is not evidence of safe traversal.
Nearest-neighbor reprojection preserves source sampled elevations; validity uses the minimum source mask over each target footprint. NoData is never filled.
Local spherical equirectangular projection is true-scale at 18.44°N; scale varies slightly across the 1 km patch. The grid is an engineering planning projection, not an official EVA safety standard.
STAC acquisition timestamps are inconsistent with the ESP orbit identifiers and are not used as authoritative acquisition dates.
